enchantment.icarus_additions.updraft.des: Crouch still to spread your wings, then jump to be lifted high into the air and straight into flight. Higher levels lift you further.
enchantment.icarus_additions.tempest.des: While flying, press sprint to spin dash forward like Riptide, then keep flying. Higher levels dash further.
enchantment.icarus_additions.zephyr.desc: Press crouch while flying to stop and hover in place, then move freely: jump to rise, crouch to sink. Double-tap crouch or land to leave the hover. Higher levels move faster.
